title: The Makers of Reality
narrativeSpine: Money’s disappearance changes rather than erases allocation, concentrating attention on consequence, desire and whose insistence can alter the shared world.
firstSceneDraft: The Makers of Reality explores a world where money no longer organizes access.
Its novel begins with needed goods immobilized by incompatible valid instructions.
Later abundance changes the problem without removing decisions about allocation.
The novel examines how power changes when prices disappear.
visualActionProposal: A shipment stands motionless amid incompatible valid directions; later the same material enters an allocation workshop whose display shows burdens instead of prices.
